question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**sight'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"sight"**.
 
• **sight:** It refers to the act or process of seeing or observing something. (दृश्य)
 
 
• **Example:** *It was my first **sight** of the city.*
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is that "*seeing overweight children has become a prevalent occurrence".*
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words, **"sight"** should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

**Complete Passage:** *Many parents think of overweight children as 'cute' and cuddly. However, obesity must not be (1)** seen __**as a healthy sign. (2)**__ when __**obese children grow up, they will be more prone (3)**__ to __**health problems like high blood pressure (4)**__ or __**diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common (5)**__ sight __**in many countries.*

• **thing:** It refers to an object, item, or entity, often without specifying its name or providing detailed information. (चीज़)
 
• **find:** It means to discover or come across something. (खोज)
 
• **solution:** It means solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation. (समाधान)
